scope: Read-only frontend source audit; only this review artifact written. No browser execution, backend edits, shared ledger edits or requirement certification.

existing_protections.finding: Body uses Inter followed by local ui-sans-serif/system-ui/platform fonts and sans-serif. No @font-face or external font stylesheet found in examined CSS/index; Inter is optional rather than required for readable labels.
Universal reduced-motion rule limits animation duration/iteration, transition duration and sets scroll-behavior:auto!important.
Universal reduced-motion override disables CSS animation and transitions including pseudo-elements.
Operational icons here are inline SVG with aria-hidden/focusable=false; no icon-font request is needed.
Existing scroll behavior already branches on reducedMotion(), providing a local implementation pattern.

source_confirmed_gaps.finding: scrollUnitAssignmentIntoView explicitly requests behavior:smooth without checking reduced-motion. CSS scroll-behavior:auto does not replace an explicit JavaScript smooth request.
source_confirmed_gaps.safe_fix: Use matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" for this existing scroll request. Keep assignment selection, target, centering, highlight lifecycle and scheduling data unchanged.
verification: Run the real unit-row reveal action with reducedMotion:reduce and instrument scrollIntoView to assert behavior:auto plus the exact existing assignment target.
Repeat with no-preference and assert smooth, same target and block:center.
Assert target row remains identifiable and operable with computed CSS animation/transition disabled; no request/payload changes.
source_confirmed_gaps.limits: Source-confirmed missing preference branch; no real-browser reproduction performed in this audit.

source_confirmed_gaps.finding: readonly-field uses font-family:var(--font-mono) without a fallback. No --font-mono definition exists in current src/public CSS; declaration becomes invalid and inherits the proportional body font. Other mono uses already provide ui-monospace,monospace fallbacks.
source_confirmed_gaps.safe_fix: Add var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace) at this declaration, consistent with member-match__raw and archive-all__phrase. Avoid downloading fonts or changing field semantics.
verification: On an actual readonly field, assert computed font-family includes monospace with --font-mono absent; block external font requests.
At 320px, long identifier wraps within the field and has no page overflow; label/copy action remains accessible.
Verify light/dark and 200% text do not clip the value.
source_confirmed_gaps.limits: This is a typography consistency gap; existing inherited fallback remains readable. No claim that labels disappear or control functionality currently fails.

unverified: All icon-only controls have accessible names across every operational state.
Reduced-motion browser behavior for every dialog/loading treatment.
Physical device and assistive technology checks.
